desc: Read the input string $S$ from standard input.
Construct the auxiliary string $T = S^R + \# + S$ and compute the KMP failure function (pi array) for $T$.
Extract the length of the longest palindromic suffix from the last value of the pi array.
Construct the final palindrome by concatenating $S$ with the reverse of its non-palindromic prefix.
Print the resulting string to standard output.
